page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via hyperthreading. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 single-threaded decompression falling into the bottom 25%, while single-threaded gzip compression is poor at the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core and parallelized execution metrics, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with PassMark memory and CPU scores, also align with average tier performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that can leverage multi-threaded execution to offset its lower single-core efficiency. The instance is suited for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale multi-threaded application hosting. It is also capable of handling basic text processing and small-to-medium language model inference tasks, provided they do not require GPU acceleration or high-speed local storage.
